column1: # Vendor issues someone has looked at. The vendor-limits watchdog
# (scripts/check-vendor-limits.mjs) still shows them in every run, as
# warnings, until the date given, and fails only for a failing vendor
# row that is not here (or whose date has passed).
#   vendor (exactly as the run table names it)
#   detail_contains (text the row's detail must contain: the cause you looked at)
#   acknowledged_until (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, inclusive, at most 30 days out)
# Anything else fails the run again: another status, another cause for
# the same vendor, a passed date. A line that matched nothing is flagged
# in the run so it gets deleted.
# This repository is public: notes say what is known and who owns it,
